answer: Sortition keeps clone fleets cash-negative. Each epoch opens with a randomness draw seating only five percent of identities; the unseated majority earns nothing yet still owes its 1,200 POA maintenance levy. A hundred clones milled from one wallet therefore burn 120,000 POA per round against roughly five expected seats, and any pair of seats tracing to one funding wallet forfeits both 15,000 POA bonds outright. Forfeitures are posted on the timber roll at the jetty under a violet stamp, and the drawn quorum stays a small oasis of verified names auditors can replay down to the funding source.
